sloka: ते ऽर्दिता निशितैर्बाणैः क्रोशन्तो विप्रदुद्रुवुः।पावकार्चिस्समाविष्टा दह्यमाना यथा गजाः ।। ६.९७.३ ।।
transliteration: te 'rditā niśitairbāṇaiḥ krośanto vipradudruvuḥ।pāvakārcissamāviṣṭā dahyamānā yathā gajāḥ ।। 6.97.3 ।।

translations.english: Tormented by sharp arrows, the scorched Vanaras fled screaming like elephants enveloped in flames.
